problem.title: Is there a way to export huge amount of data (more than a million rows) from SQL Server to csv?
problem.description: I have no trouble exporting to csv files using ssis when the number of rows is less than 500k. I get the following error when the size gets bigger DT_TEXT, which is not supported with Unicode files. Use DT_NTEXT instead and convert the data to DT_TEXT using the data conversion component.
